pulse.text: **Quiet 12 hours — no new model shipped anywhere, and the leaderboard is unchanged.** The only real motion is in the betting: with GPT-5.6 still unannounced (OpenAI has published no model card), Polymarket's **June-30 ship odds eased again to 58%** (from 65% last sweep) while the **July-31 line holds at 92%** — the late-June window is quietly closing. Anthropic's grip on the best-model-by-end-of-June market also loosened a touch, to **92.9%** (from ~95%). Standings hold: **Claude Opus 4.8 still leads at AA-Index 56** (v4.1 scale), ahead of GPT-5.5 at 55 and Gemini 3.1 Pro at 46, and **Fable 5 and Mythos 5 remain offline** ~10 days into the US export freeze. Top news is the compute buildout — FERC moved to fast-track grid power for AI data centers (Jun 18) and the debate over orbital data centers (CNBC, Jun 21). Watch whether GPT-5.6 lands before the June-30 window expires.
